mods.name: Roundwood
mods.description: Round 2x2 and arched 1x2 wooden doors, round windows with arch, corner and edge profiles and independently styled Cross Beams placed by aiming at a face, open 2x2 archways (ordinary and keyhole), and one Universal Trim for all of them, restyled in the world with any planks, painted with any dye, or (trims and archways) faced with brick.
